label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_01
text: Hey, welcome to Blueberry Academy!\c\nIt’s pretty wild the first time you come to school\nby riding a subway to an undersea elevator, huh?

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_02
text: Way to go, new Champion! Pretty impressive that\nyou managed to take down Kieran.

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_03
text: Things have been extra lively here at school\nsince you showed up!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_05_01
text: I forget which biome my next class is in...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_06_01
text: We gotta bundle up if we’re headed to the Polar\nBiome. Brrr...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_01
text: So you’re the exchange student people keep\ntalking about? You don’t LOOK that strong...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_01
text: At our school, you won’t cut it if you can’t hold\nyour own in a Pokémon battle.

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_02
text: From how you look, I’d never have guessed what\na good Pokémon battler you are!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_02
text: I can’t believe Kieran lost to you. Not even\nDrayton could beat Kieran!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_03
text: I want to get as strong as you are!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_03
text: Paldea must be full of skilled battlers like you!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_14_01
text: Man, no matter how many Poké Balls I have, it’s\nnever enough...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_15_01
text: You should go do some BBQs. Once you’ve\nearned the BP, you can buy some nice Poké Balls.

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_01
text: This court’s used for official BB League battles!\c\nYou should see how packed the seats get when\nthere’s a Championship match!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_01
text: I saw your battle with Lacey! I’d never seen some\nof those Pokémon before!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_02
text: Your Championship battle ruled! So is Kieran\ndemoted back down to the Elite Four now?

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_02
text: I saw your battle with Kieran! He sure looked\nunhappy about the outcome, though...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_03
text: I wanna become Champion one day too! I gotta\nput in a lot of work first...

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_03
text: After seeing you battle so much, I think I’m a fan\nof yours now!

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_26_01
text:
Here at Blueberry Academy, it’s Double Battles
or nothing.\c
I guess that’s probably because they open up
your strategic options.

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_48_01
text: Why not try catching a Rhyhorn in the Savanna\nBiome?

label: bbschool_entrance_npc_49_01
text: I just can’t get my head around the material in\nRock-Type Studies II...

label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_01
text: Plusle’s Ability is called Plus!\c\nIt gets a boost to its Sp. Atk when it battles\nalongside Minun!

label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_10
text: I can’t remember my type matchups. I keep\nhaving to look at my notes during battle.

label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_11
text:
Type matchups are much easier to grasp when
you think about how the world works!\c
Plants wither in the cold, right? So logically,
Grass types are weak to the Ice type!

label: bbschool_class_a_ni_npc_03
text: This classroom’s actually underwater!\c\nThey just display video of the sky on these\nscreens so it doesn’t feel too claustrophobic.

label: bbschool_class_a_ni_npc_04
text: When it’s night outside, the sky you see in the\nTerarium will look like night too. The displays are\r\nsynced to the real time on the surface.

label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_01
text: Yeah, Carmine’s kinda self-absorbed, but it’s\nhard not to like her anyway.

label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_02
text: Our class has Amarys, the student council prez...\nand Carmine, the student body pest!

label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_08
text: Did you know that if you run in tight circles for a\nbit, you’ll end up spinning in place?

label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_09
text: There’s this one spot down in the Terarium’s\nmeadows where there’s always a breeze blowing.\r\nIt’d be fun to go spin and spin in the wind there.

label: bbschool_class_b_ni_npc_02
text: One time I was walking in the meadows in the\nTerarium when a breeze blew in out of nowhere.\r\nI thought I heard someone singing... So weird!

label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_01
text: I wanna work at a Poké Mart in the future, so I’m\nresearching what items here are big sellers.

label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_06
text: If you want a TM, but you can’t make it ’cause\nyou need some material that a Pokémon drops...\r\nyou can just buy the TM with BP here instead!

label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_07
text: The move Helping Hand does wonderful things in\nDouble Battles!

label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_09
text: You can buy Poké Balls and Potions from vending\nmachines around the Terarium.

label: bbschool_shop_ni_npc_01
text: Which Pokémon can I use a hunk of Metal Alloy\non...? Guess it’s gotta be a metallic one...

label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_03
text: The dishes here taste super rich, but they give\nMeal Powers that help with all Pokémon types!\r\nIf you’ve got the BP, try ’em out!

label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_04
text: The Canyon Biome’s the best for picnicking!\nIt feels nice just being in Amarys’s territory!

label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_05
text: There’s no better place to enjoy a sandwich than\nthe Coastal Biome! Lacey’s plaza is there too!

label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_14
text: You’ve got to clear the Elite Trials if you want\na shot at battling the Elite Four.

label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_15
text: I can’t handle heights! No way can I do Amarys’s\nElite Trial!

label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_03
text: I think Drayton’s my favorite of the Elite Four.\nHe’s so strong, even though he seems so lazy!

label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_04
text: Crispin of the Elite Four... He’s kinda absent-\nminded, but that’s pretty cute!

label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_09
text: Brrr. I’m still chilly from a jaunt in the Polar\nBiome. Better warm up with a slice of pizza!

label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_13
text:
Every dish here at the cafeteria is a personal
favorite of Director Cyrano’s!\c
None of them look very...balanced, nutritionally
speaking—but the Meal Powers are unbelievable!

label: bbschool_clubroom_default_02
text: My Tyrogue loves this treadmill!

label: bbschool_clubroom_default_03
text: Pikachu and I are doing our best to fight our way\nup the BB League!

label: bbschool_clubroom_gorgeous_03
text: The clubroom’s so flashy now. Meowth loves it!

label: bbschool_clubroom_gorgeous_04
text: Meowth has its claws out and looks eager to\nuse them!

label: bbschool_clubroom_fancy_02
text: Lacey must love the clubroom’s new fancy look!

label: bbschool_clubroom_future_02
text: Metang looks right at home when the clubroom’s\ndone up like this!

label: bbschool_clubroom_future_04
text: Man, the room looks cool this way! Way to go,\nArt Club!

label: bbschool_clubroom_future_06
text: W-wait, isn’t that the mysterious UFO?! Like,\nthe one from the movies?!

label: bbschool_clubroom_retro_02
text: Some of the Pokémon hanging out in this room\nseem like the sort to make holes in things.\r\nI sure hope they don’t...

label: bbschool_clubroom_monotone_01
text: Blitzle blends right in with the room’s new black-\nand-white decor! It’s so cute!

label: bbschool_clubroom_monotone_04
text: Skarmory’s really tough—did you know that? It’s\ngot very few weaknesses.

label: bbschool_clubroom_natural_02
text: You brought nature right to the clubroom! The\ngrass Pokémon look thrilled about it!

label: bbschool_clubroom_dark_05
text: Thank you for veiling the clubroom in this\ndarkness. We’re grateful for the gloom.
